slides.h: YOUR PACKAGING IS YOUR ONLY [[PHYSICAL AD]]
slides.dek: It is the one piece of your brand every customer is guaranteed to hold in their hands.

body: Online, your brand is pixels until the doorbell rings. The parcel is the first real thing a customer touches. It says careful or careless before the product does.
Beautiful and broken loses to plain and intact every time.
Protection is step one of presentation. A dented product undoes everything printed on the box.
A handwritten thank-you card and clean inner wrap cost a few rupees per order. That is the cheapest moment of delight you will ever buy.
Customers photograph parcels worth photographing. Every shared unboxing is an ad you did not pay for, from a voice buyers trust more than yours.

slides.body: Ship a parcel to a friend and open it together like strangers. You will find at least one thing to fix.
